newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash maize steady to firm.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash maize steady to firm.

text.p: Argentine cash maize was steady to slightly firmer on good volume at Buenos Aires Cereals Market, with more hearty buying from exporters seeking to fill ships in port, traders said.
Prices paid to farmers for maize in Rosario rose $1 to $113. Cash sunflower seed rose $5 in Rosario to $220, on good crush margins. Sunflower volume was middling.

Soybeans were steady in a moderate volume market free of major news, staying at $298 in Rosario. Wheat prices jumped on fears of cold U.S. weather, rising $5 to $153 in Bahia Blanca in tight physical trade.
